* Class representing the ASN.1 INTEGER type.
 * @hide This class is not part of the Android public SDK API

methods.name: public static ASN1Integer getInstance(Object obj)
methods.comment:
* Return an integer from the passed in object.
     *
     * @param obj an ASN1Integer or an object that can be converted into one.
     * @return an ASN1Integer instance.
     * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the object cannot be converted.

methods.name: public static ASN1Integer getInstance(ASN1TaggedObject obj, boolean explicit)
methods.comment:
* Return an Integer from a tagged object.
     *
     * @param obj      the tagged object holding the object we want
     * @param explicit true if the object is meant to be explicitly
     *                 tagged false otherwise.
     * @return an ASN1Integer instance.
     * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the tagged object cannot
     * be converted.

methods.name: public BigInteger getPositiveValue()
methods.comment:
* in some cases positive values get crammed into a space,
     * that's not quite big enough...
     *
     * @return the BigInteger that results from treating this ASN.1 INTEGER as unsigned.
